notes.subject: givim gutpela tok long
notes.rationale: ברך literal i 'mekimuk wantaim/kneel' — long Tok Pisin, gutpela tok i klostu long mining bilong blessing

notes.subject: ונשאם
notes.rationale: 'karim ol' (nasa = lift/carry) o 'salim ol i kamap bikpela' (exalt) — KJV 'lift them up' vs ASV 'bear them up'

notes.subject: עמך/נחלתך/ורעם/ונשאם
notes.rationale: ol suffix -ך (-k bilong yu) i kamap namel namel, tupela tok i pinis wantaim -ם (ol) — wanpela lain kos bilong ol man bilong Yahwe

translation: Salvim ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong yu, na givim gutpela tok long ⟨את⟩ samting ol i kisim i go olsem pikinini bilong yu; na lukautim ol olsem sipsip, na karim ol i go inap taim olgeta.
